name: Corporate Coup
description: A chartered company buys the charter-holder's colony governors, then declares independence with its fleet and the bought colonies. Depends on 19c chartered companies for the charter relation itself; on this branch a company is stubbed through a clearly-named hook (registerSubjectCompany).
